title: Finishing Foot Stroking
summary: Very light smooth passes gradually reduce contact intensity.
startingPosition: The foot is relaxed and supported.
instructions: Stroke the sole with broad contact.
Move to the top very lightly.
direction: Over the whole foot with decreasing pressure.
warning: Do not massage with recent injury, marked swelling, ulcers, infection, severe pain, or impaired sensation unless medically advised.
imageAlt: Educational diagram: finishing foot stroking, without text labels.
